text: Walked in off the street. I was after a new set of plates and to extract a couple of teeth. Dentist and staff very supportive and professional. At all times they made me feel at ease. The price was very affordable. The turn around was 3 days. Highly recommend and will revist for future procedures. Thank you team.

Dr Pat is a very good dentist! His assistants are also great- lovely ladies.
I had a lot of work done here and am very happy with his work and I feel more confident with my smile! Highly recommend for any dental work here. Very good pricing too, pre quoted everything. I’ll be back :-)

unfortunately I have to give Dr. Thiparpat a negative review. not about the quality of his excellent work as a licensed dentist, but on the prices advised outside and on the counter. when I was showed the bill for fillings: the prices were doubled without even informing me beforehand. I ended up paying 4000B for 4 fillings when I should normally have paid 2000B. but strangely the doctor was not present when I paid the bill. dishonest practices.
Quick and professional cleaning done by the dentist and his assistant.
Awesome and affordable price. Dr and his staff was amazing! You can't ask more than that. Lovely crew and job was excellent done!!
Great work! Good prices! Definitely recommend

This dentist is the worst.
He pulled my tooth out without even taking an X-ray.
What's more, the fee was supposed to be 500, but he charged me 3,000.
The pain didn't go away even after the extraction, so I had to go to another dentist for treatment.
You gave me way too much!
A very good doctor and reasonable prices - I recommend him.
